integrity: The proof uses the published bounded-GPE characterization and a deterministic exact-integer exhaustive check. No probabilistic search or floating-point acceptance criterion is used.
limitations: The result determines only \(D_b(9)\); it gives neither a general formula nor a uniform asymptotic bound for \(D_b(n)\). The lower bound is a finite exhaustive certificate specific to nine variables.
title: The first unresolved bounded Genocchi--Peano degree is \(D_b(9)=30\)
